text: Russian Ground Forces (RGF) highly likely seized approximately 200 sq km of Ukrainian territory in April 2025, an average of approximately 6 sq km per day Pokrovsk has likely remained the priority axis for Russia in its campaign but it has been unable to make any notable advances around the city since late 2024 While Russia conducts its Victory Day commemorations on 09 May 2025 for its role in what Russia calls the ‘Great Patriotic War, Ukrainian forces highly likely continue to conduct limited kinetic operations in Russia’s Kursk border region
